async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the Orders page using relative URL
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales/order/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Filter for fraud suspect orders by selecting 'Fraud Suspect' in the status combobox
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('Fraud Suspect')
    # Apply the filter by clicking the 'Search' button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by date to get the earliest order by clicking the 'Date' column header
    await page.get_by_role('columnheader', name='Date').click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for sorting to take effect
    # Get the customer name from the first row of the table (skip header row)
    first_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(1)  # Index 1 for first data row
    customer_cell = first_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(0)  # Assuming first cell is customer name
    customer_name = await customer_cell.text_content()
    # Return the customer name as the result
    return customer_name
